system.description:
Choose one permanently. Cute: when your companion is targeted by a Strike, roll a Heart Check against the attacker's CR; on a success the companion is Steeled. While it is Near, you may re-roll failed Heart Checks to charm. Vicious: your companion gets +1 Attack Action. While it is Near, you may re-roll failed Heart Checks to intimidate.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.52

automation.note: Choose Cute or Vicious when you take this ability. The choice is permanent.

automation.label: Cute only: when your companion is targeted by a Strike, target the companion; CR = the attacker's CR
automation.onSuccess: Your companion is Steeled until its next Combat Turn starts.

automation.note: Cute: while your companion is within Near Range (15 ft), you may re-roll failed Heart Checks to charm.
Vicious: your companion gets +1 Attack Action on its Combat Turn. While it is within Near Range (15 ft), you may re-roll failed Heart Checks to intimidate.
